pillar_reactions.evidence: Engaged on mechanics throughout rather than on the promise: 'my question is just more for the time of the training, it 35, 45 minutes?', 'do we have to film every one of our training?', and he benchmarked his own kit against the programme — 'I have a 12, 2-16, a 20... I don't know if you can use that and maybe it's too light or too heavy.' He also volunteered his dip and pull-up bars and asked whether they still had a place.

Agreed without resistance — 'Yeah, yeah, definitely, yeah' — and the fit was made easier because his one hard boundary matched the method: 'There's one thing I don't want to do... it's tracking calories', answered with 'you're lucky then because Trevor hates tracking calories as well.'

Accepted the check-in and video-feedback loop and self-identified the one risk in it: 'Sure. Yeah, sure. Then, yeah, I think I will need to push myself sometimes, you know, to write a message.' He named the mental-load relief as the single most valuable element: 'for me, it's not having to think about the training.'

anchors.raw: it's just the fact that I just relaunched something, you know, with ChatGPT, kind of a program that I just done before session, but I want something more tailored
anchors.note: His current programme costs nothing and is generated by an LLM fed with his Whoop data. He is dissatisfied with it for a specific and articulable reason — it agrees with him — which is the strongest available wedge, and the rep did use it. But the baseline price in his head when he hears $6,000 is zero.

anchors.raw: I have never done training. So that's quite some money.
anchors.note: Six years of results achieved entirely without paying anyone. He has no reference price for coaching at all, so the number arrives with nothing to compare against.

anchors.raw: it's me, I had like a, more or less like a 1.5k in mind, you know, something like that, that's what I had in mind
anchors.note: Stated ceiling is 1.5k for the full engagement, roughly 29% of the euro price. The rep then priced the fallback tier at $1,000, landing just under the ceiling — the anchor set the price rather than the other way round.

anchors.raw: a new car that needs to be purchased... that's already a 20k investment, so on top of that, I'm fully transparent, that's quite a big investment to add on that at the moment
anchors.note: The competing claim on the money is four times the price of the programme and is already decided. Combined with the wife's move to a lower-paying job, the household's discretionary capacity is genuinely reduced, not merely perceived to be.

anchors.raw: so I did like, I don't know, eight weeks, calisthenic program I found online
anchors.note: His prior structured training also came free off the internet and he completed it. Programme structure is not something he has ever had to buy.

anchors.raw: I never say yes on the call, whether it's on the phone, whether it's on video. I used to work in sales as well.
anchors.note: A stated, sales-literate refusal to transact live. Any close on this call was unavailable regardless of price, which is worth knowing before discounting to force one.

unmet_demand.want: Tailored one-to-one coaching from Trevor at something near a 1.5k budget
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The only thing available near that number is the community tier, which the rep himself described as 'everything that we just talked about, just without the complete one-on-one programming with Trevor himself' — the tailoring is precisely what he said he wanted when he rejected the AI programme.

unmet_demand.want: To train with no equipment at all while travelling
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He raised it directly — 'I'd like to be able to do with nothing as well when I am in those situations where I have nothing to train' — and it was never answered. Whether the programme provides equipment-free sessions was left unresolved.

unmet_demand.want: Programming that supports a half marathon in November alongside the strength work
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep asserted the workouts would 'directly impact your half-marathon' but nothing concrete was offered on integrating a running block, and he was moved to the non-tailored tier where nothing can be built around the race at all.

unmet_demand.want: Wrist and shoulder strengthening so heavy Turkish get-ups stop failing at the wrist
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He named this as his specific limiter twice. It was acknowledged once in passing — 'so you need strength in the wrists as well' — and never appeared again in the pillar delivery or the tier he was actually sold.
